dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual geometric narrowing from the mid-section, accelerating into a sharp taper at the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Asymmetrical protrusion visible on the left lateral margin in the mid-body region, followed by a slight indentation toward the posterior.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light grey/off-white median intensity; transitionary phase between juvenile slate and mature white.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency, diffuse darker grey shading localized along the central dorsal ridge and the posterior-most taper.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient between the primary light grey baseline and the darker shaded regions.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A single, dark, thin curved linear mark is present on the posterior right dorsal surface; multiple small, high-contrast white spots are visible along the mid-left lateral margin.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Linear shadow-casting ridge or indentation visible along the central longitudinal axis of the upper dorsal plane.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent curved dark linear scar or mark on the lower right dorsal quadrant near the peduncle.
